spec.name: Furniture Shoe Rack
spec.description: A low, two-tier birch shoe rack with four sturdy corner posts, rear retaining rails, and three neatly arranged pairs of blocky boots. Honey-brown and muted sage boots sit below a centered terracotta pair. Front faces negative Z; all geometry stays within the requested margins.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: low two-tier birch shoe rack with three pairs of neatly arranged blocky boots. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
